about: Premium challenge library for couples (docs/03-feature-spec.md §8). Source of truth for supabase/seeds/10_challenge_library.sql: edit here, then run `node content/challenges/build-seed.mjs`. Content stays PG. The 5 free presets live in supabase/seeds/00_preset_challenges.sql and must not be repeated here.

challenges.title: Breakfast at the table
challenges.description: Sit down for breakfast together, even a quick one. Phones stay in another room until the plates are cleared.

challenges.title: Tea and ten questions
challenges.description: Make two warm drinks and take turns asking each other questions you have never asked before.

challenges.title: Plan a small adventure
challenges.description: Pick a place neither of you has been, near or far, and plan the day together on paper.

challenges.title: Watch the sunset
challenges.description: Find a spot with a view of the sky and stay until the light is gone. No photos needed.

challenges.title: Tidy one corner as a team
challenges.description: Choose one drawer, shelf or corner and sort it out together. Music allowed, scrolling not.

challenges.title: Bake something sweet
challenges.description: Cookies, banana bread, anything that makes the kitchen smell good. Share the first piece.

challenges.title: Rose, thorn and bud
challenges.description: Each share the best part of your day, the hard part, and one thing you are looking forward to.

challenges.title: Dream out loud
challenges.description: Spend a while talking about one thing you would love to do together in the next year.

challenges.title: Grocery run for two
challenges.description: Shop for the week side by side with a paper list. Each of you adds one treat for the other.

challenges.title: Look through old photos
challenges.description: Pull out printed photos or an album and tell each other the stories behind them.

challenges.title: Slow morning
challenges.description: Stay in, make coffee, and give the first hour of the day to each other before any screen.

challenges.title: Picnic, indoors or out
challenges.description: Spread a blanket in the park or on the living room floor and eat together with nothing else going on.

challenges.title: Read side by side
challenges.description: Each bring a book, share the couch, and read for a while. Swap one favorite line at the end.

challenges.title: Make a playlist for us
challenges.description: Take turns choosing songs that remind you of each other, then listen to it start to finish.

challenges.title: Stargaze for a while
challenges.description: Step outside after dark, look up, and see how many stars or planets you can find together.

challenges.title: Weekly check-in
challenges.description: Sit down once this week to talk about what went well for the two of you and what you each need next week.

challenges.title: Dinner from somewhere far away
challenges.description: Choose a place you would love to visit and make a dish from there, figuring it out as you go.

challenges.title: Phone-free date night
challenges.description: A whole evening out or in, planned by both of you, with both phones tucked away from start to finish.

challenges.title: Bring them a coffee or tea
challenges.description: Make your partner's favorite warm drink, just the way they like it, without being asked.

challenges.title: Take a chore off their list
challenges.description: Quietly do one task your partner usually handles, so they don't have to today.

challenges.title: Give a real compliment
challenges.description: Tell your partner one specific thing you admire about them, out loud and face to face.

challenges.title: Plan a small surprise
challenges.description: A favorite snack, a flower, a silly drawing. Something little that says you were thinking of them.

challenges.title: Listen all the way through
challenges.description: Ask about their day and listen until they are done. No fixing, no phone, just you.

challenges.title: Make their favorite meal
challenges.description: Cook the dish your partner loves most and serve it with a little ceremony.

challenges.title: Say thank you for something small
challenges.description: Notice one everyday thing your partner does and thank them for it properly.

challenges.title: Give a shoulder rub
challenges.description: Ten unhurried minutes for tired shoulders, with nothing expected in return.

challenges.title: Pack them a lunch
challenges.description: Put together tomorrow's lunch for your partner and tuck in a tiny note.

challenges.title: Warm up their morning
challenges.description: Do one thing that makes their morning easier: clear the car, set out breakfast, start the kettle.

challenges.title: Tell them a favorite memory
challenges.description: Share one memory of the two of you that still makes you smile, and why it stayed with you.

challenges.title: Give them an hour off
challenges.description: Take over whatever needs doing for an hour so your partner can rest or do something just for them.

challenges.title: Hide three little notes
challenges.description: Leave three short notes in places your partner will find through the day: a pocket, a mirror, a mug.

challenges.title: Ask about their dream
challenges.description: Ask your partner about something they are hoping for, and find one small way you could help.

challenges.title: Greet them at the door
challenges.description: When your partner comes home, stop what you are doing and give them a proper hello.

challenges.title: Draw them something
challenges.description: A portrait, a comic about your day, a map of your first date. Skill is not required.

challenges.title: Call someone they love
challenges.description: Reach out to a friend or family member your partner cares about, just to be kind to their people.

challenges.title: Run them a bath or set up a rest
challenges.description: Prepare a cozy half hour for your partner: a bath, a blanket and a book, their favorite chair.

challenges.title: Board game night
challenges.description: Pick a board game or a deck of cards and play a full round. Winner chooses dessert.

challenges.title: Do a puzzle together
challenges.description: Start a jigsaw, a crossword or a sudoku and work on it side by side for a while.

challenges.title: Paper and pencil games
challenges.description: Tic-tac-toe, hangman, dots and boxes. Best of five, with full bragging rights.

challenges.title: Draw each other
challenges.description: Sit face to face and sketch each other for five minutes. Reveal at the same time and try not to laugh.

challenges.title: Build a blanket fort
challenges.description: Chairs, sheets, pillows. Build it properly, then spend some time inside.

challenges.title: Read aloud to each other
challenges.description: Take turns reading a chapter, a poem or a short story out loud.

challenges.title: Living room karaoke
challenges.description: Put on songs you both know and sing them badly and loudly, together.

challenges.title: Make something with your hands
challenges.description: Fold paper, paint, knit, build a model. Start a small project and work on it together.

challenges.title: Homemade pizza night
challenges.description: Make the dough or buy it, then each top your own half. Trade a slice.

challenges.title: Two truths and a wish
challenges.description: Each share two true things about your week and one wish. Guess which is which, then talk about the wish.

challenges.title: Plant something
challenges.description: Pot a herb, sow some seeds or repot a plant together, and decide who waters it.

challenges.title: Visit a library or bookshop
challenges.description: Wander the shelves and each pick out a book for the other to read.

challenges.title: Taste test at home
challenges.description: Line up three kinds of chocolate, fruit or tea. Taste them blind and rank your favorites.

challenges.title: Write a story together
challenges.description: Take turns adding one sentence at a time until your story has a beginning, a middle and an ending.

challenges.title: Learn a card trick
challenges.description: Learn one card trick or coin trick on your own, then perform it for your partner.

challenges.title: Museum or gallery visit
challenges.description: Go and see something together. Each choose one piece you would take home and say why.

challenges.title: Candlelight evening
challenges.description: Turn off the lights and screens for an hour and spend it by candlelight, talking or playing a game.

challenges.title: Make a time capsule
challenges.description: Each write a letter to your future selves, add a few small keepsakes, and seal it with a date to open.

challenges.title: Morning stretch together
challenges.description: Ten easy minutes of stretching side by side before the day begins.

challenges.title: Dance in the kitchen
challenges.description: Put on three songs you both love and dance while dinner cooks.

challenges.title: Bike ride for two
challenges.description: Take the bikes out for a ride with no particular destination.

challenges.title: Take the long way home
challenges.description: Walk home together by a route you don't usually take and notice three new things.

challenges.title: Hike somewhere green
challenges.description: Find a trail, a forest path or a big park and spend a good while walking in it together.

challenges.title: Play catch or frisbee
challenges.description: Take a ball or a frisbee outside and play until one of you calls for a break.

challenges.title: Yoga for two
challenges.description: Roll out two mats, or two towels, and move through a gentle routine at the same pace.

challenges.title: Swim together
challenges.description: Head to a pool, a lake or the sea and get in the water together.

challenges.title: Garden or balcony hour
challenges.description: Weed, water, sweep and plant together until the space looks loved.

challenges.title: After-dinner stroll
challenges.description: A short walk around the neighborhood after you eat, hand in hand if you like.

challenges.title: Try a new sport
challenges.description: Badminton, bowling, climbing, table tennis. Pick something neither of you is good at yet.

challenges.title: Stairs instead, all day
challenges.description: Skip the lift and the escalator for a whole day, then tell your partner how it went.

challenges.title: Workout side by side
challenges.description: Do a workout together at home, outdoors or at the gym, each at your own level.

challenges.title: Walk to get coffee
challenges.description: Leave the car and walk together to a café a little further away than usual.

challenges.title: Learn a dance step
challenges.description: Pick a simple dance, a waltz or a two-step, and practice until you can both do it without counting.

challenges.title: Morning move, on your own
challenges.description: Start your day with a run, a walk or a stretch of your own, then tell your partner about it.

challenges.title: Explore a new neighborhood
challenges.description: Go somewhere in your town you rarely visit and explore it on foot together.

challenges.title: Clean the house to music
challenges.description: Put on an upbeat album and clean together until it ends. Dancing between rooms counts.
